تستحقون (form X)
# تَسْتَحِقُّونَ (tastaḥiqqūna) /tas.ta.ħiq.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# تُسْتَحَقُّونَ (tustaḥaqqūna) /tus.ta.ħaq.quː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
